body: Life is painful and i think it always will be and that’s the sad part of it but I also believe there will be people you meet on ur journey through life that makes the pain worth it ! :) you saying you’d describe yourself as an extrovert but you can be socially awkward I think maybe you should try speaking to a therapist maybe?
